calendarMeta.rule: Session assignment follows the approved dated master plan; current Google Calendar shift controls the displayed timing window.

cardioGuide.basis: Starting walking-pad ranges calibrated around recent Apple Health ordinary walking speed (~2.46 mph); RPE/talk test overrides speed.

brisk.feel: Purposeful walk; breathing elevated but full sentences still comfortable.

fast.feel: Strong purposeful walk, controlled and never a sprint.

cardioGuide.adjustment: Start at the low end. Change speed by ~0.1–0.2 mph as needed to match the target RPE; do not force a listed speed if form or breathing says otherwise.
